image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism has an elongated oval shape with a distinct central row of eight overlapping calcareous plates (valves). These plates are surrounded by a thick, textured girdle covered in small, scale-like or spiny structures with purple and brown coloration. The central plates show some dark pigmentation and possible algae growth. The background consists of blurred rock textures.
